intro: You shop for shoes in the online shop Pace & Sole. Do the four tasks in order. Use only the data in the tasks, not your own data.

tasks.title: Find a product
tasks.text: Add the trail running shoe Ridge Runner to the cart: size 43, color Moss.

tasks.title: Compare products
tasks.text: Add the cheapest waterproof hiking boot that is available in size 42 to the cart. Any color is correct.

tasks.title: Place the order
tasks.text: Place the order with standard delivery. Use this data: Alex Novak, alex.novak@example.com, Lipowa 12, 80-001 Gdansk, Poland. Pay on delivery.

tasks.title: Ask a question
tasks.text: Use the contact form. Ask if you can return the boots after 40 days. Give the number of your order.
